correction.what_was_wrong: ROUND28's next-step suggestion named 'ROUND25 开发块（1301000..1301015）' as the scene family already containing on-time failure records under the same model and greedy decode. Two things are off: (1) 1301000..1301015 is the ROUND22/24 development block that ROUND25 itself documents as 'kept as development history only', not a ROUND25 block; (2) it is not the block that contains the reported failing scene 1400031, which sits in the ROUND25 evaluation block 1400000..1400063.
correction.consequence: one cannot expect 1301000..1301015 to yield the 1400031-kind rescuable failure labels; its own on-time failures (5/16 scenes under seed33 final greedy, already recorded on disk from ROUND24) are development-history scenes with their own failure instances, not the ROUND25 evaluation failure. Any future use of that block is reuse of development history, and its outcome numbers are already known without new launches.
